map.SBTT过短可能影响小肠病变检出率。研究显示SBTT与胶囊完成率呈负相关。: An overly short SBTT may lower the detection rate of small-bowel lesions. Studies show SBTT is inversely correlated with capsule completion rate.

map.提示：胶囊内镜完成率约80-90%。GTT延长可缩短SBTT可用时间，影响远端小: Note: Capsule endoscopy completion rate is about 80-90%. A prolonged GTT shortens the available SBTT window and affects distal small-bowel examination. An unexpelled capsule needs abdominal X-ray confirmation; retention beyond 2 weeks requires evaluation for surgical retrieval. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：胶囊内镜胃/小肠通过时间评估: 📚 Deep Dive: Capsule Endoscopy Gastric/Small-Bowel Transit Time Assessment
map.小肠检查质量：由吞服、达十二指肠、达回盲瓣时间算 GTT 与 SBTT: Small-bowel examination quality: derive GTT and SBTT from swallow, duodenal arrival, and ileocecal arrival times
map.胃轻瘫筛查：GTT 延长提示胃排空障碍: Gastroparesis screening: a prolonged GTT indicates impaired gastric emptying
map.病变检出率评估：SBTT 过短可能影响远端小肠阅片: Lesion detection rate assessment: an overly short SBTT may affect distal small-bowel reading
map.算法：时间转分钟（HH:MM）；胃通过时间 GTT = 达十二指肠 − 吞服；小: Algorithm: convert times to minutes (HH:MM); gastric transit time GTT = duodenal arrival − swallow; small-bowel transit time SBTT = ileocecal arrival − duodenal arrival. GTT ≤60 min normal, 61~90 min mildly prolonged, >90 min clearly prolonged (gastroparesis); SBTT 180~360 min normal, <180 min too short (affects detection), 361~480 min prolonged, >480 min clearly prolonged; total bowel transit >480 min suggests possible constipation.
map.例：08:00 吞服、08:25 达十二指肠、11:30 达回盲瓣 → GTT: Example: swallow at 08:00, duodenum at 08:25, ileocecal valve at 11:30 → GTT 25 min (normal), SBTT 185 min (normal, good detection rate). If swallowed at 08:00, duodenum only at 10:00, ileocecal valve at 14:00 → GTT 120 min (clearly prolonged, suggesting gastroparesis), SBTT 240 min (normal); gastric emptying function should be evaluated and a prokinetic used.
map.SBTT 偏短为什么反而不好？: Why is a too-short SBTT actually undesirable?
map.SBTT 过短（<180min）说明胶囊在小肠里停留不足，远端小肠尤其是回肠末段: An SBTT that is too short (<180 min) means the capsule did not dwell in the small bowel long enough, so the distal small bowel, especially the terminal ileum, is under-imaged and small ulcers, vascular malformations, or early tumors may be missed. Reading must be especially careful; repeat examination or switch to enteroscopy if necessary.
map.胶囊一直没排出要紧吗？: Is it a problem if the capsule is never expelled?
map.若 48~72 小时仍未确认排出，应行腹部 X 线确认是否滞留。绝大多数可随粪便: If expulsion is still unconfirmed after 48~72 hours, an abdominal X-ray should confirm whether it is retained. The vast majority pass in stool; with known small-bowel stricture or a history of retention there is a risk of capsule impaction requiring preoperative evaluation.
